name: Niche
description: A niche with a shell head: a round-topped opening in a plain field.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: linear-gradient(#000 0 0), radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 46%, #000 40%, transparent 40%); mask: linear-gradient(#000 0 0), radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 46%, #000 40%, transparent 40%); -webkit-mask-composite: xor; mask-composite: exclude; } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
